Oneliner

Remote sensing camera with a resolution of 10m@550km and a swath width of 25km.
Description

Commercial remote sensing satellite independently developed by Beijing Weina Star Technology Co., Ltd.  Equipped with a remote sensing camera with a resolution of 10m@550km and a swath width of 25km. The maximum data downloading rate is 4Mbps. At present, the satellite performs reliably in orbit.
Notes

This launch is not only the third launch mission of Weiner Star, but also the second satellite adopting the company MN-10 platform.
